saint-augustine-art-craft-festival.notes: St. Augustine Art Association discontinued the Annual Art & Craft Festival (last presented Nov 2019; 2020 cancelled). Listed staugustineartfestival.com timed out/unreachable. No 2026/2027 STAAA Art & Craft Festival dates or fees. Separate Francis Field events (e.g. Old Town Art Show, St. ARTistine) are different promoters.

saint-louis-art-fair.fullAddress: Downtown Clayton, MO; office 8235 Forsyth Blvd #205, Clayton, MO 63105
saint-louis-art-fair.notes: 33rd annual presented by Emerson, Sept 18-20, 2026. Phone 314-863-0278. Site confirms dates/artists; dollar booth/application fees were published via the 2026 ZAPP call (not restated on main site HTML).

santa-fe-folk-art-market.fullAddress: Santa Fe Railyard Park, Santa Fe, NM
santa-fe-folk-art-market.notes: 23rd IFAM July 8-11, 2027 (2026 was July 9-12). No application fee; booth $700 + sales commission (10% first-time / 20% returning). Selection + Placement committees. Eligibility limited to artists outside US or immigrant folk traditions. Phone +1 505 992 7609.

santa-fe-indian-market.fullAddress: Santa Fe Plaza, Santa Fe, NM (SWAIA: 207 Shelby Street, Santa Fe, NM 87501)
santa-fe-indian-market.notes: 104th Santa Fe Indian Market Aug 15–16, 2026; upcoming Aug 21–22, 2027. Small 5x10: $600 (1 artist) to $950 (3); Large 10x10: $900 (1) to $1400 (4). Collaborator $25; youth $15. Payments due May 15, 2026. 2026 artist apps closed; 2027 cycle info Dec 2026. artistservices@swaia.org / communications@swaia.org.

sausalito-art-festival.notes: No live Labor Day festival currently scheduled for 2026/2027. Foundation seeking alternative location after Marinship Park loss; accepting interest form for future applications. Juried panel historically 8-10 judges; ~220 artists when active.

scottsdale-arts-festival.notes: Classic Scottsdale Arts Festival (Civic Center Mall juried outdoor fair) not listed as returning for 2026/2027 on scottsdalearts.org. Scottsdale Arts currently promotes Merchantile Market vendor weekends and Scottsdale Family ArtsFest (student-focused, Mar 6–7 2026)—not equivalent to the historic arts festival. Booth fees/deadlines for a 2026/2027 Scottsdale Arts Festival omitted as not published.

sedona-arts-festival.fullAddress: 995 Upper Red Rock Loop Road, Sedona, AZ
sedona-arts-festival.notes: Sat 9am–5pm, Sun 10am–4pm. Weekend admission $15. Oldest/largest Sedona premiere arts festival; ~100 artists historically. Artist booth fees not published on sedonaartsfestival.org public pages.

smithsonian-craft-show.notes: 2027 show Apr 7–11 at NBM (homepage). 2026 call page: $50 app fee; booths $1,605–$2,300. Three expert jurors; ~120 artists. Prefer 2027 dates; 2026 booth fee range cited from official 2026 call page pending 2027 update.

st-james-court-art-show.venueName: Historic Old Louisville (St. James Court / Belgravia / 4th / 3rd / 1300 / West End Baptist)
st-james-court-art-show.notes: 70th annual Oct 2–4, 2026. Section app fees $35–$40; deadlines mostly May 1 (1300 Association June 1; Belgravia open until full). Booth fees vary by section (e.g. Fourth St ~$565–$575; Belgravia $625). $10,000 in awards (not booth fee). Juried per section.

state-street-ann-arbor-art-fair.venueName: State Street District (Liberty, North University, Maynard, East William, State, Thompson)
state-street-ann-arbor-art-fair.fullAddress: 527 E. Liberty, Suite 210, Ann Arbor, MI 48104
state-street-ann-arbor-art-fair.notes: 58th Ann Arbor State Street District Art Fair 2026. Fine Artist deadline Mar 2; Marketplace Apr 1. Juried by practicing artists and arts professionals. Official site is now statestreetdistrict.org (listed .com was unreachable). Booth fees not posted on official site.

stockley-gardens-arts-festival.fullAddress: Stockley Gardens Park, historic Ghent, Norfolk, VA 23507
stockley-gardens-arts-festival.notes: Listed ghentonline.com unreachable; Hope House Foundation hosts the festival (hope-house.org). Fall 2026: Sat Oct 17 10am–5pm, Sun Oct 18 12–5pm. Artist apps Jun 1–Jul 15 2026 on Zapplication. Spring 2027: May 15–16, 2027. 125+ artists; contact Laura DeVore ldevore@hope-house.org. 100% proceeds support Hope House. Booth/$ application fees not stated on hope-house.org event page (apply via ZAPP).

sun-valley-arts-and-crafts-festival.notes: Listed svcenterarts.org unreachable/500; current festival site sunvalleyartsandcraftsfestival.com (Altitude Events Group). 57th Annual Aug 14–16 2026. Apps Dec 1 2025–Mar 20 2026; $35 nonrefundable jury fee; notify Apr 2; booth fee due May 11. Booths: $450 regular 10x10; $500 corner; $1000 10x20. Panel of 6 local artists/collectors; 120 booths; 6,000+ attendees. Free admission.

tempe-festival-of-the-arts.fullAddress: 1 W. Rio Salado Parkway, Tempe, AZ 85281
tempe-festival-of-the-arts.notes: Fall 2026 Dec 4–6 (apps closed Aug 15). Spring 2027 Mar 12–14; apps Oct 1–Dec 15, 2026. Corner booth +$105. Emerging AZ artists $265 booth. ~350 artists; ~225,000 visitors per festival (official site). Blind selection jury (~5).

three-rivers-arts-festival.notes: 2026 Dollar Bank Three Rivers Arts Festival June 5–7 & 11–14 at new Arts Landing home. Free admission. Artist Market call closed; fee schedule not on current TRAF artist pages.

traditional-spanish-market-santa-fe.fullAddress: Santa Fe Plaza, Santa Fe, NM
traditional-spanish-market-santa-fe.notes: Centennial year (founded 1926); Sat–Sun 8am–5pm. Now operated via Traditional Spanish Market / Atrisco Heritage Foundation (traditionalspanishmarket.org); listed spanishcolonial.org no longer hosts market pages. New-artist screening due Jan 26, 2026; jury registration Mar 16, 2026; artist booth registration due May 15, 2026. Booth fee amount not stated on public pages.

tubac-festival-of-the-arts.notes: 68th Annual; hosted by Tubac Chamber of Commerce. Artist/exhibitor apps via ZAPP (fees not published on tubacaz.com). Wed–Sun village-wide outdoor show.

uptown-art-fair.notes: 2026 return as Art on the Isles Aug 7–9 after hiatus. Official uptownartfair.com is Uptown Association site; detailed booth/app fees not published there at capture time.

utah-arts-festival.fullAddress: Library Square, downtown Salt Lake City, UT
utah-arts-festival.notes: 50th annual June 18-21, 2026 (passed as of Aug 2026). $45 app; $650 standard / $750 corner booth. Jury Feb 28–Mar 1; notify Mar 13; booth fee due Apr 3. Check uaf.org Nov 2026 for 2027 cycle.

washington-square-outdoor-art-exhibit.notes: Historic Greenwich Village exhibit reportedly suspended since ~2024; official sites unreachable / no 2026–2027 edition facts found. Omit dates/fees until revival announced.

wells-street-art-festival.fullAddress: 1400 N Wells Street area, Chicago, IL
wells-street-art-festival.notes: 2026 festival June 13–14 with 127 artists; produced by Old Town Merchants & Residents Association. wellsstreetartfest.com unreachable; .us is live official. Booth fees not on thank-you homepage.

woodlands-waterway-arts-festival.fullAddress: 2099 Lake Robbins Dr., The Woodlands, TX 77380
woodlands-waterway-arts-festival.venueName: The Woodlands Waterway & Town Green Park
woodlands-waterway-arts-festival.notes: Apps open Aug 1, 2026; live artist image jury Nov 7, 2026; notifications Nov 23; payment due Dec 19, 2026. ~200 juried fine artists. Sponsor page cites 20,000+ consumers. Booth fees not listed on public pages.
